latest_release.name: v1.0.46
latest_release.body:
## Changes

- Improve candidate selection for the confirmed strong V2 medium watermark pattern on 768×1376 images, including the 48×48 anchor with 73px right/bottom margins.
- Preserve canonical candidate priority and existing moderate-evidence/content-protection checks. No new watermark template or broader search range is introduced.
- Some fine contour residuals remain; this release does not claim complete removal for all V2 images. Video behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- CI: 1,738 tests passed, 33 skipped, 0 failed; SDK and release-surface checks passed.
- All 424 frozen baseline outputs remain pixel-identical to 1.0.45.
- The reported candidate-selection case now uses the reviewed 48×48 anchor; changes are confined to its watermark region. Sample provenance remains unknown, with controlled fixtures providing independent reproduction.

The npm SDK, userscript, and extension artifacts are included below. The website uses a separately pinned SDK and requires a separate update and deployment.
